In this interview, we speak to Vilas Shinde, the man behind a company with an annual turnover of 2,600 crore. His journey is an inspiring story of determination, entrepreneurship and the power of collective farming.
Vilas Shinde started with a vision but faced enormous financial challenges. In the early days, he had to take loans and was burdened with a debt of 75 lakh. However, instead of giving up, he continued working towards his goal. Today, his company has grown into a major agricultural enterprise, working in association with more than 35,000 farmers. Watch the interview to know more.
